entities.name: Shilgengar
entities.description: An extremely powerful demon lord who indirectly created the vampires of Innistrad.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: An aging human alchemist manipulated into turning to blood magic; creator of the vampire bloodlines.

entities.name: Marycz
entities.description: An angel strung up and exsanguinated by Edgar Markov in Shilgengar's Ritual.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker and vampire of Innistrad indirectly created by Shilgengar.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: Land that suffered a great famine caused by Shilgengar.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane whose vampires Shilgengar indirectly created.

entities.name: Shilgengar's Ritual
entities.description: Ritual in which Edgar Markov exsanguinated the angel Marycz.

events.summary: Shilgengar caused a great famine in the lands that would become Stensia.
events.quote: Shilgengar caused a great famine in the lands of what would become Stensia

events.summary: Shilgengar manipulated Edgar Markov into turning to blood magic to find food for his kin.
events.quote: manipulated the aging human alchemist Edgar Markov into turning to blood magic

events.summary: Edgar exsanguinated the angel Marycz and shared her blood with the nobility, creating the vampire bloodlines.
events.quote: Edgar strung the angel Marycz up in his laboratory and exsanguinated her

relations.note: Indirectly created the vampires including Sorin
